class.name: RailVehicleSwitches
class.brief_description: Configures cab control panel switch behavior (impulse vs. toggle) and the headlight dimmer.
class.description: [RailVehicleSwitches] wraps the FIZ [code]Switches:[/code] and [code]DimmerList:[/code] sections. [member pantograph_impulse], [member converter_impulse] and [member motor_connectors_impulse] are the kinds of the cab's pantograph, converter and line contactor switches. [member relay_reset_button_1]/2/3 assign the relays of the cab's relay reset buttons. [member pantograph_presets] is what the cab's pantograph selector offers. [member modern_dimmer] and [member dimmer_list_positions] are the cab's headlight dimmer, not ported; [member pantograph_preset_default] is no key of the original.

method.name: get_pantograph_preset
method.description: The preset the pantograph selector of the cab at [param end] selects.

method.name: get_pantograph_preset_position
method.description: The position of the pantograph selector of the cab at [param end].

method.name: next_pantograph_preset
method.description: Moves the pantograph selector of the cab at [param end] one position on, within [member pantograph_presets].

method.name: previous_pantograph_preset
method.description: Moves the pantograph selector of the cab at [param end] one position back.

method.name: universal_relay_reset
method.description: Resets the relays [param button] is assigned ([member relay_reset_button_1] and its twins), when the vehicle has its low voltage.

members.member: [code]Switches:Converter[/code] Whether the converter switch is impulse-type. Defaults to bistable (false) if not specified in the FIZ file.
[code]DimmerList:Cycle[/code] Whether the dimmer switch can be rotated all the way around.
[code]Switches:ModernDimmer[/code] Whether the vehicle is equipped with a multi-position headlight dimmer switch.
[code]Switches:MotorConnectors[/code] Whether the line contactor switch is impulse-type. Defaults to impulse (true) if not specified in the FIZ file (the opposite default of the other switches).
[code]Switches:Pantograph[/code] Whether the pantograph switch is impulse-type. Defaults to bistable (false) if not specified in the FIZ file.
[code]Switches:PantographPresets[/code] What each position of the cab's pantograph selector raises, a [enum PantographPreset] each.
[code]Switches:RelayResetButton1[/code] Bitmask of relays reset by button 1.
[code]Switches:RelayResetButton2[/code] Bitmask of relays reset by button 2.
[code]Switches:RelayResetButton3[/code] Bitmask of relays reset by button 3.

constants.constant: The pantograph over the end of the cab the driver sits in.
